sections.Profile:
Happy Days, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in July 1952, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker. Gottlieb built 1,150 units.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1952
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
